_comment: Smelting recipes for Mining's Smelting sub-skill (WoW real: Smelting is NOT a separate profession/skill number - it shares Mining's own skill level, confirmed via web search 2026-09-12). 'inputs' is a dict of material_id -> quantity consumed per smelt. 'output' is the material_id produced (always quantity 1 per smelt - WoW's real convention, no bulk-smelt-for-more-bars mechanic). 'skill_required' gates who can smelt this at all (below this, the recipe doesn't appear). Smelting has NO fail chance (Kyle, 2026-09-12: 'guaranteed success always') - skill only gates ACCESS to a recipe, never whether it works once you have access, unlike gathering's orange/yellow/green/grey. Basic ore-to-bar recipes are 1:1 (Kyle: 'start 1:1 for lower tier stuff'). Bronze and Steel are real WoW composite recipes made from BARS, not raw ore (Bronze = Copper Bar + Tin Bar, Steel = Iron Bar + Coal) - confirmed via web search, not invented.

bar_bronze._note: Real WoW recipe: Bronze Bar = 1 Copper Bar + 1 Tin Bar, not raw ore. Requires bars already smelted first, a genuine two-step chain.

bar_steel._note: Real WoW recipe: Steel Bar = 1 Iron Bar + 1 Coal (raw ore, not a coal bar - coal is never smelted on its own in real WoW). skill_required set below WoW's real 65+ threshold since our whole early/mid bracket is compressed to a 0-150 range rather than WoW's 1-300.
